module_contract.title: 在线视频播放
module_contract.subtitle: 使用 media_kit 播放在线 HTTP 视频流并操控播放参数
module_contract.generated_analysis: AI_ANALYSIS.md (auto-generated via tool/generate_harness_ai_analysis.sh, DO NOT hand-edit)

implementation_steps.detail: add dependencies: media_kit ^1.2.6, media_kit_video ^2.0.1, media_kit_libs_video ^1.0.7; run flutter pub get
import package:media_kit/media_kit.dart; add MediaKit.ensureInitialized() immediately after WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()
add com.apple.security.network.client=true to BOTH macos/Runner/DebugProfile.entitlements and macos/Runner/Release.entitlements (insert alphabetically, keep existing keys untouched)

wrap Player + VideoController; openAndPlay() opens Media(sampleStreamUrl) with play:true; expose play/pause/togglePlayPause/seek(Duration)/setVolume(double 0-1)/setRate(double); ValueNotifier<PlayerUiState> uiState (idle/loading/playing/paused/error) + ValueNotifier<Duration> position/duration + ValueNotifier<double> volume/rate; listen player.stream.position/duration/playing; dispose() disposes all notifiers + player; error branch catches open failure and sets uiState=error

StatelessWidget taking adapter; Row: play/pause IconButton (loading -> CircularProgressIndicator, disabled), position/duration text (mm:ss), DropdownButton rate 0.5x/1.0x/1.5x/2.0x; Slider for seek (max=duration, disabled when zero, clamp), Row: volume icon + Slider + percent text; all via ValueListenableBuilder on adapter notifiers

MyHomePage StatefulWidget; initState -> adapter.openAndPlay(); dispose -> adapter.dispose(); LearningScaffold(title, floatingActionButton refresh -> openAndPlay, interactiveDemo: AspectRatio 16:9 with ValueListenableBuilder on uiState: error->error placeholder, idle->idle placeholder, else Stack[Video(controller), loading overlay]; below: VideoPlayerControls + sample URL text; sections: LearningObjectives/ConceptChips/CodeSnippetCard/CommonPitfalls/ExerciseCard as in reference module)
OnlineVideoPlayerEntry extends StatelessWidget -> const MyHomePage(title: '在线视频播放')
import online_video_player/module_entry.dart; append ModuleEntry to _modules platform section with ALL required metadata fields

modules array append ['platform','online_video_player','/online-video-player','ready',['flutter_study_learning','media_kit','media_kit_video','module_registry']]; categoryMeta.platform children array append 'online_video_player'; depends array append 'media_kit' 'media_kit_video'
run bash tool/generate_harness_ai_analysis.sh; verify no git diff on generated docs; AI_MODULE_INDEX count 17->18

test/modules/platform/online_video_player/online_video_player_test.dart: widget test with a FAKE adapter (subclass or mock, no real Player in test env); assert controls render, play/pause toggles icon, error state shows error placeholder; keep tests hermetic (no network)
bash tool/quality_gate.sh; flutter build macos --debug (must succeed, proves libmpv native link)
